about_the_game:
BRING THE WORLD BACK TO LIFE

The world is burned, and as always, the Pouics awaken to repair this devastated environment. But faced with the scale of the catastrophe, these naive and curious little creatures will need your help to guide them; you are their Guardian.

Guide them and protect them from the environment, but above all from themselves; unaware of the danger, you will need to be reactive to bring them to the source of this destruction.

Together, bring nature back to life. Each Pouics helps life to bloom again when planted, but be vigilant, the burned areas never stop expanding. You will have to plant vegetation strategically if you want to reach the origin of these scorched lands.

GUIDE YOUR FLOCK OF POUICS

The more Pouicus you plant, the more Pouics you'll get! Gather them together and plant the environment all the way to your goal without letting them scatter. Move in a ball on either side of the herd to keep it compact and allow you to progress efficiently.

Are you a few meters short of reaching the next Pouicus? Throw a Pouic! Light and rounded, they will always perfectly reach the point you are aiming for.

Your worst enemies? Cliffs, lakes, and the biggest threat to the concentration of Pouics: butterflies!

PREVENT BURNED AREAS FROM SPREADING

As the Guardian of the Pouics, you must guide them strategically and cunningly. The scorched lands will continue to expand until their source is appeased. Only the cliffs can block the expansion of these zones.

With your Pouics, reach other Pouicus, but above all, don't lose them! Otherwise, the terrible Malpouics will appear…

The closer you get to the source of the scorched earth, the faster it will spread. Reforest the entire area, being careful not to leave any charred patches or you might lose your progress.

SOLO OR CO-OP WITH UP TO 4 PLAYERS

Invite your friends to join you and paint nature with 2, 3, or 4 players. If you manage to organize yourselves, it will be easy to guide the Pouics to the end. Remember to communicate, observe the others, and above all, coordinate, or you might accidentally roll over your friend's Pouics…

Together, replant the world around you at your own pace and join forces to soothe the burning rock. You have all the time in the world, but as soon as you approach the source of the scorched lands, you must reach it at all costs. If you scatter or retreat too far, you risk losing Pouicus and summoning Malpouics, who will add difficulty to your progress.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 4300G
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Spread nature and breathe life back into a world of ash by guiding the Pouics, naive and curious little creatures. They dream of reawakening the world, but they can’t do it alone. Guide them, calm them, protect them and help them restore life to a forgotten land.
